Plot sgRNA count distribution histogram

Source: R/report.R
plot_sgRNA_histogram.Rd

This function generates histograms of sgRNA count distributions for different treatments and timepoints

Usage

plot_sgRNA_histogram(
  counts = NULL,
  ggsci_style = "JCO",
  treatment_name = "FGF401",
  control_name = "DMSO",
  num_bins = 100,
  title_x_top_margin = 12,
  title_y_right_margin = 12,
  plot_fontsize = 11
)

Arguments

counts

A data frame containing sgRNA counts with sgRNA IDs as row names

ggsci_style

The style for the color palette from the ggsci package (default is "JCO")

treatment_name

The name of the treatment used in the experiment (default is " FGF401")

control_name

The name of the control used in the experiment (default is " DMSO")

num_bins

The number of bins to use in the histogram (default is 100)

title_x_top_margin

Top margin for the x-axis title (default is 12)

title_y_right_margin

Right margin for the y-axis title (default is

plot_fontsize

Font size for the plot text elements (default is 11

Value

A list of ggplot2 objects representing the sgRNA count distribution histograms
